description:
Bind the Extension.UIContext stubs to real TUI implementations in Interactive mode.

Wire up all 24 UIContext methods:
- Dialogs: select → overlay+select_list, confirm → overlay+yes/no, input → overlay+input
- Notifications: notify → flash message, set_status → footer update
- Working indicators: set_working_message/indicator → spinner in footer
- UI customization: set_widget (inject component), set_footer/header (override)
- Editor control: paste_to_editor, set/get_editor_text
- Theme: get/set_theme, get_all_themes
- Tool expansion: get/set_tools_expanded

This makes extensions able to interact with the TUI.
Upstream: interactive-mode.ts lines 1900-1955
Depends on: overlay, theme, UIContext (from Phase 6), footer wiring
title: Wire UIContext into Interactive mode
